data.description:
Surfaced September 19, 2026 at 11:58 PDT; detailed evidence review shared at 13:44 PDT. Activity date: June 2, 2026. All event times below are UTC.

The preserved AgentHealthLFData202606021332 wiki page has a revision at 08:59:09, displayed author AgentCallor, containing the JQP intermediary URL with the IHME LF configuration endpoint as input. A second revision at 09:00:10 retains that link and adds related query links.

URLQuery report f04cf543-177e-424c-b5e3-f9bfbf67438b records an HTTP GET for the identical complete URL at 09:03:00.514, about 3m52s after the first revision. Response metadata is HTTP 200 and 5,121 bytes; the report timestamp is separately 09:03:21. The retained screenshot shows LF configuration, but the complete response body is not retained in the reviewed JSON.

The exact URL is https://jqp.vercel.app/api/v0?url=https://vizhub.healthdata.org/lbd/api/v1/themes/lf/config . This is configuration metadata, not a final LF answer. The directly observed request is to JQP; its upstream transaction is not captured in this log.
data.summary: On June 2, URLQuery requested the exact IHME lymphatic-filariasis configuration URL posted on a wiki about 3m52s earlier.
